dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' shaped structure on the lower posterior flank features a jagged, high-contrast light perimeter; a large 'C' shaped structure on the mid-dorsal region shows a sharp gradient from a bright exterior arc to a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity light pixel clusters concentrated in the cervical and posterior regions; the mid-lateral section displays a low density of these features, appearing as a more uniform dark field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the posterior 'O' annulus, the mid-dorsal 'C' structure, and the primary cervical cluster form a wide-angled scalene triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense 'collar' of speckled high-intensity spots at the base of the neck and distinct symmetrical light-colored rings surrounding the orbital regions.
